harness: Each mutant runs the passing named control first, asserts its exact source anchors are unique, applies the mutation, and requires the mutant to fail by the named assertion. An import, syntax or unrelated runtime error does not count as a kill.

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_CENSUS
controls.proves: the prepared deployment shape (19 in-tree node_modules symlinks) is accepted, the row reports symlinks: 19, and the whole report is ok:true

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_ESCAPE
controls.proves: a symlink whose text resolves outside the checkout root refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_ESCAPE before the target is reached

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_ESCAPE_EXISTING
controls.proves: a symlink to an existing file outside the checkout root refuses with the same named code

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_ESCAPE_REALPATH
controls.proves: in-tree link text whose resolved real path leaves the checkout refuses with the same named code

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_DANGLING
controls.proves: an in-tree dangling symlink refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_UNRESOLVED

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_LOOP
controls.proves: an in-tree symlink cycle refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_UNRESOLVED

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_WRITABLE_TARGET
controls.proves: a group/world-writable symlink target refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_WRITABLE

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_UNREADABLE_TARGET
controls.proves: an entry the service identity cannot read refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_ACCESS

controls.name: HOST_CHECKOUT_ANCESTOR
controls.proves: a symlinked ancestor of the checkout path refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_ANCESTOR

controls.name: HOST_ENV_MULTILINK
controls.proves: the measured /usr/bin/env chain with nlink = 115 is accepted and the report is green

controls.name: HOST_INSTALLED_SINGLE_LINK
controls.proves: an installed file with a second hard link still refuses with ACT_PREREQUISITE_CUSTODY

controls.name: HOST_MULTILINK_WRITABLE_TARGET
controls.proves: a group/world-writable multicall target still refuses with ACT_PRODUCTION_EXECUTABLE

controls.name: HOST_MULTILINK_FOREIGN_OWNER
controls.proves: a foreign-owned multicall target still refuses with ACT_PRODUCTION_EXECUTABLE

controls.name: HOST_MIRRORED_REFUSAL
controls.proves: a mirrored runtime refusal carries mirrored_code and mirrored_from; a direct runtime refusal carries neither

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_BAN
mutants.mutation: reinstate the blanket symlink rejection in the probe

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_CENSUS
mutants.mutation: drop the symlink census from the row

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_DANGLING
mutants.mutation: accept an unresolvable chain element instead of refusing

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_LOOP
mutants.mutation: replace the cycle refusal with a bounded hop counter

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_READ_PROOF
mutants.mutation: delete both read/traverse proofs (entry and resolved target)

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_ANCESTOR
mutants.mutation: delete the checkout ancestor custody requirement

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_ENV_MULTILINK
mutants.mutation: apply the installed-file single-link rule to the measured executable again

mutants.name: HOST_KILL_INSTALLED_SINGLE_LINK
mutants.mutation: drop the single-link rule for installed files

retained_assertions.SHU71_CHECKOUT_NO_SYMLINK: retained; expected code corrected in place to ACT_PREREQUISITE_CHECKOUT_SYMLINK_ESCAPE because the link points outside the checkout root
retained_assertions.SHU71_CHECKOUT_READABILITY: retained; its mutant anchor moved to the probe read/traverse call
retained_assertions.H1_ABSENT_STATIC_*: retained; each now pins the exact mirrored or direct runtime row shape

known_limit: The resolved-target readability call cannot be falsified alone in this model, because the whole-tree walk already reads every in-tree path; HOST_KILL_CHECKOUT_READ_PROOF removes both read/traverse calls together.
